steps.action: First-run: create the first Administrator; Skip optional steps on the Welcome step opens Outbound email while email is not configured
steps.expected: Outbound email step with the unset warning, no Set up later, Continue unavailable

Skip optional steps opened /welcome?step=email with "Set up outbound email to finish instance setup. OpenLaw uses it for invitations, sign-in links, and notifications." The step had no Set up later (buttons ["Save relay","Back","Continue"]) and Continue was disabled.

steps.action: Wizard email steps 4 to 6 with STARTTLS and Username and password: Save relay stores the credentials encrypted and never returns them; the TLS upgrade must succeed before delivery
steps.expected: Relay saved; no credentials in the page or API; stored value not plain text; Send test email fails; nothing delivered
steps.actual: Save relay showed "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.". The step read "Outbound email is set in the app. Mail is sent from "DOC-032 Stored" <stored-relay@helix.example>.". GET /api/v1/email-settings returned only {"source":"app","fromAddress":"\"DOC-032 Stored\" <stored-relay@helix.example>"}; neither the page nor the API contained the SMTP username or password. org_settings.smtp_url held a 191-character value without the host, username or password in plain text. Send test email against Mailpit, which offers no STARTTLS, showed "The test email could not be sent. A secure connection could not be established. Check the connection security setting and the relay's TLS certificate." and Mailpit received 0 messages.

steps.action: Wizard email steps 6 and 7: Replace relay opens an empty form; Keep current relay closes it; replace with None and None; Send test email
steps.expected: "Test email sent to" the Administrator; OpenLaw test email with Outbound email works, Sent through and From; Continue available
steps.actual: Replace relay opened an empty form {"host":"","username":"","password":"","senderName":"","senderEmail":""}. Keep current relay closed it and the settings stayed {"source":"app","fromAddress":"\"DOC-032 Stored\" <stored-relay@helix.example>"}. Replace relay with SMTP server mailpit, Port 1025, None, None, Sender email stored-relay@helix.example and Sender name DOC-032 Stored showed "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.". Send test email showed "Test email sent to doc032-bridge-wiz-admin@helix.example. Check your inbox.". Mailpit received "OpenLaw test email" from DOC-032 Stored <stored-relay@helix.example>; the body said Outbound email works, Sent through mailpit:1025, From "DOC-032 Stored" <stored-relay@helix.example>. Continue became available.

steps.action: Emails with no organization name and no logo show OpenLaw and the OpenLaw mark in their header
steps.expected: Test email header names OpenLaw with the OpenLaw mark
steps.actual: On the unnamed bwiz instance a test email's header read "OpenLaw" with the inline image openlaw-mark@openlaw.

steps.action: Wizard email step 7: a relay that cannot be reached saves but fails its test; Replace relay again with all details and retest
steps.expected: A saved relay alone does not prove delivery; the corrected relay delivers
steps.actual: An unreachable SMTP server saved with "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.", but Send test email showed "The test email could not be sent. The relay host could not be found. Check the SMTP server name.". Replace relay, all details entered again, Save relay, and a second test showed "Test email sent to doc032-bridge-wiz-admin@helix.example. Check your inbox." and delivered "OpenLaw test email" from stored-relay@helix.example.

steps.action: Wizard email step 8: Clear relay removes the saved relay and stops delivery when there is no environment override; save a valid replacement
steps.expected: Relay cleared; source unset; Continue unavailable; no mail; replacement delivers
steps.actual: Clear relay showed "Relay cleared. This instance can no longer send email." The source became unset and Continue was disabled. A password setup request answered 503 and Mailpit received 0 messages. After a valid replacement was saved, a test message arrived again from stored-relay@helix.example.
